name: Review every lost deal and roll up what to change
summary: Reviews every lost deal, records why it was lost, and rolls up the reasons into what to change. Crons read the pipeline and draft; a person decides every change and every re-open.

all.evidence: 6 discovery calls describe how they review lost deals, all by hand

covered_by.ask-the-client: skill (the owner calls the client; the workflow lists the deal and its recorded reason, and drafts nothing to the client)
covered_by.root-cause-review: draft (a review record per lost deal) plus skill (the owner decides the cause)
covered_by.rollup-report: draft (weekly roll-up of lost and won counts and top lost reasons)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Read the lost deals and their lost reasons into the workflow store. Marks deals that are no longer lost.

crons.name: review
crons.summary: Draft a review record for each new lost deal. Queue a re-open for deals lost to a nurture reason inside the window, for approval.

crons.name: rollup
crons.summary: Weekly roll-up of lost and won counts and the top lost reasons (22:00 UTC Sunday is 8 or 9 am Monday in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads and internal records only. The crons read lost and won opportunities and their lost reasons, and write review records and roll-ups to the workflow store. The one live operation, re-opening a lost deal, is only queued for approval.

gohighlevel.covers: lost and won opportunities, lost reasons, re-open of a lost deal (on approval)

gaps: HubSpot: the reads are mapped (deal search, pipelines), but the closed-lost stage differs per pipeline and the lost-reason property is not confirmed in the supplied pages. No adapter yet; needs a live account to confirm the stage and property.
Zoho: the supplied docs are Zoho Books help pages, not Zoho CRM deal pages. No lost-deal step is documented, so no adapter.
Ask the client why they went elsewhere: this is a person's call. No approved reply template exists, so the kit drafts nothing to the client.
Root-cause review and the decision on each change: the owner makes them. The kit has no write path for the owner's notes or decisions yet; they are recorded by hand until a review tool exists.
Price comparison against a winning offer or competitor: no platform in the evidence documents it.
Pipeline and stage changes (process-change): not built. Changing a pipeline touches the whole team, so it stays a person's job until a live operation is mapped and approved.
Coaching the rep and sharing lessons with the team: no platform in the evidence documents it.
The adapter is docs-only until a sandbox GoHighLevel sub-account proves the reads and the re-open.

evidence.calls: 6 construction and trade discovery calls describe reviewing lost deals; all six are by hand, with no tool named
evidence.platforms: GoHighLevel: 6 of 16 steps supported, 2 partial, 5 unknown, 1 not supported; HubSpot: 0 supported, 5 partial; Zoho: CRM not documented (Books help only)
